**Finding: missing** (TRANSITION — post-termination transition assistance and data return)

- **What I checked:** Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination), Section 9 (Termination), Section 15 (Customer Data and Privacy), Section 16.5 (return/destroy of Confidential Information), Section 27.2 (BC/DR), plus document-wide searches for "transition", "export", "delete", "Section 11".
- **Gap:** Section 10.1 only assumes "any agreed transition period" without creating one; Section 10.2 covers Deliverables and refunds only. Section 16.5 carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy duty and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15" — **Section 11 does not exist** in the Agreement, and Section 15 governs processing/privacy, not exit. So there is no enforceable obligation to return, export, or delete Customer Data, and no migration assistance commitment. That fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance + 30-day export) in a hosting agreement.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new Section 10.3 at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return/export of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter, with a routine-backup/legal-retention carve-out to stay consistent with Section 16.5. The comment offers the 90-day fallback.
